Terms of Service

Last updated: November 7, 2026

By using Meowshift (“the App”), you agree to the following terms.

1. The service

The App provides scheduling, attendance and leave records, pay estimates and reconciliation, reminders and shift alarms, data backup / sync and some AI-assisted features. Features may change with app updates.

2. Estimates and AI content

Pay, overtime pay, leave and other figures are estimates based on what you enter and the App's rules. They are not an employer's payslip or accounting, tax or legal advice. AI content is only for organizing and explaining; for anything important, rely on your company's official documents, the rules of the relevant authorities or professional advice.

3. PRO subscription

On iOS, PRO is an auto-renewable subscription provided through the Apple App Store; on Android, through Google Play. Available plans, prices, currency and the actual billing time are as shown on the purchase screen and in each store.

Unless you cancel before the store's deadline, your subscription auto-renews on the monthly or yearly plan you chose and the store charges you. On iOS, manage or cancel in your Apple ID's “Subscriptions”; on Android, in Google Play's “Payments & subscriptions”. Deleting your App account is not the same as cancelling your store subscription.

Restore purchases is available under “Me → Plan”. Refunds and payment disputes are handled under the Apple App Store or Google Play purchase and refund policies.

4. User accounts

You're responsible for keeping your third-party sign-in accounts secure. You may not use the App for anything illegal, to infringe others' rights, to disrupt the service or to attempt unauthorized access.

5. Data and backups

Some data is stored only on your device by default. Without active PRO cloud sync, deleting the App, clearing browser / App data or a device failure may cause data loss. We recommend exporting a backup of important data regularly.

6. Account deletion

You can permanently delete your account and its directly linked cloud data in the App. Where needed for legal compliance, payment audits, fraud prevention or dispute handling, some transaction events unlinked from the account may be kept as the law allows.

7. Availability

We work hard to keep the service running, but we can't guarantee every feature will be uninterrupted at all times, on every device or under every third-party service condition. Outages of third-party sign-in, the App Store, cloud or AI services may affect related features.

8. Apple terms

If you get the App through the Apple App Store, Apple's Media Services, purchase and licensing terms also apply. Unless a custom EULA is specified in App Store Connect, the Apple Standard EULA applies.

9. Copyright

The app's interface design, character illustrations and text are the copyright of the app's developer. Please don't reproduce them or use them commercially without permission.

10. Changes to these terms

These terms may be updated when features or laws change. By continuing to use the service after an update, you accept the latest terms.
